items.title: File Einspruch against the fine notice
items.quote: Binnen zwei Wochen nach der Zustellung dieses Bescheids kann Einspruch eingelegt werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Stadt Musterhomburg (Saar) – Ordnungsbehörde.
items.computation: The notice was formally served via Postzustellungsurkunde (§ 182 ZPO); page 2's delivery record states 'zugestellt' with the date 24.11.2026, so this stated service date is used directly (no 4-day deemed-delivery presumption applies to formal service). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of service itself (Tue 24.11.2026) is not counted. The two-week Einspruch period (§ 67 Abs. 1 OWiG, § 43 StPO) ends 14 days later on the day matching the weekday of the triggering event: Tue 08.12.2026. That day is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Saarland, so no shift is needed.

items.title: Pay the total fine amount (after the decision becomes final)
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Gesamtbetrag erst nach Rechtskraft, und zwar innerhalb von zwei Wochen.
items.computation: Payment is due only once the Bußgeldbescheid is 'rechtskräftig' (final), which — assuming no Einspruch is filed — occurs the day after the Einspruch period expires, i.e. 09.12.2026 (the day after 08.12.2026). The day Rechtskraft occurs is not counted (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB); the two-week payment period (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) then ends 14 days later on Wed 23.12.2026, a normal working day, so § 193 BGB causes no shift. This date is conditional: it only applies if no Einspruch is filed by 08.12.2026; filing an Einspruch stops Rechtskraft and this payment deadline from arising.

warnings: Page 2 shows a scanned Zustellungsurkunde with a handwritten service date of 24.11.2026; this stated date was used as the actual delivery day instead of the statutory deemed-delivery presumption for ordinary post.

The payment deadline (23.12.2026) is calculated on the assumption that no Einspruch is filed; if an Einspruch is lodged by 08.12.2026, the fine does not become final on the assumed date and this payment deadline does not apply as computed.
The notice about the Kundenbüro in der Lindenhofer Straße being closed on 14.12.2026 is unrelated to either deadline above and does not change them.

The place names (Musterhomburg, Musterwadern, Beispielwadern) and the sender's email domain look like placeholders, suggesting this may be a template or test document; verify the IBAN DE86 5945 0010 0004 2401 00 and the contact details independently (e.g. via the city's official website) before relying on or paying this notice.
A well-formed IBAN only confirms its checksum and bank code, not who actually owns the account; do not rely on this letter alone to confirm the payee.
